
# Sprint `<N>` Report — `<Sprint Title>`

> **How to use this template:**
>
> Copy this file to `docs/sprints/sprint-0<N>-<topic>.md`.
>
> Replace every placeholder, remove the guidance lines (blockquotes), and document only work that has actually been completed.
>
> - Check a learning objective only when you can demonstrate the skill.
> - Distinguish expected results from actual observations.
> - Do not invent command outputs, test results, or evidence.
> - Mark incomplete work clearly and explain what remains.
> - Use "Not applicable" when a section does not apply to the sprint.
